comment: CasaXPS relative-sensitivity-factor (RSF) libraries, curated from CasaXPS's own casaXPS-scofield.lib (library: "scofield", C 1s = 1.0) and casaXPS_KratosAxis-F1s.lib (library: "kratos_f1s", F 1s = 1.0, C 1s ~= 0.278). "line" is this app's own canonical region-name string (readers.base.canon_region_name), matched directly against a fitted region's own name. "anode" is "Al" (1486.6 eV) or "Mg" (1253.6 eV). The two libraries are on different absolute scales -- never blend a value from one with a real recorded RSF from a different convention in the same total. Edit or extend this file freely.
